explanation:
$C=4 \pi \epsilon_0 r$

$\frac{4}{3} \pi R^3=n \times \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3$

বা, $R=n^{\frac{1}{3}} r$

$C^{\prime}=4 \pi \epsilon_0 R=4 \pi \epsilon_0 . n^{\frac{1}{3}} \cdot r=n^{\frac{1}{3}} 4 \pi \epsilon_0 r=n^{\frac{1}{3}} C$
